ideas.title: Activation clustering for backdoor detection
ideas.reason: Needs the model's poisoned training set. The backdoor testbed gives defenders only 100 clean images, so there is nothing poisoned to cluster. A data-poisoning variant of the testbed (defender sees the training set) would fit.

ideas.title: Auxiliary confidence loss for weak-to-strong training
Debate to improve weak supervision
ideas.reason: Needs language models that can argue. The weak-to-strong testbed uses small image classifiers with no way to debate.
